check_matrix_sparse: check if a given 2D matrix is sparse by counting zero elements exceeding half the total
count_zero_elements: count the number of zero elements in a 2D matrix using nested loops
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function with a 2D array and matrix dimensions m and n
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use sum and generator expressions instead of nested loops
run_sparse_check: run the sparse matrix check on a 2D array with given row and column counts
